_source: Consolidated figures from Screener.in (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, TTM), livemint balance sheet, Moneycontrol/ETMoney cash flow, company FY26 annual report and NSE filing. Price/market cap: Screener close 03-Nov-2026 (Rs 360, mcap Rs 3,078 cr). FY26 year-end mcap from Yahoo Finance key statistics (31-Mar-2026). Verify before relying on the score.
_notes: Company listed 03-Oct-2025. Only four annual periods available, so own-history percentile and 5-yr cyclical-average rules cannot run. Promoter has pledged 39.2% of holding (Screener cons); working capital days moved from -31 to 63.4; FY26 OCF negative on inventory/receivables build. These are noted, not all are scored by the framework.

forward.basis: Illustrative base case, not company guidance. FY28 sales ~Rs 3,100 cr (TTM Rs 2,747 cr), 18.5% EBITDA margin (FY26 16.8%, TTM 18.1%), D&A Rs 110 cr, interest Rs 180 cr, other income Rs 70 cr, 25% tax -> ~Rs 265 cr PAT. Assumes all five plants run for a full year after the 1,300 KLPD dual-feed conversion, working capital normalises, and no new policy shock. Long-term growth 12% is our assumption for volume-led ethanol/CBG growth.

qualitative.change_description: 1,300 KLPD grain-based dual-feed capacity commissioned at Units 1, 2 and 4; all five ethanol plants operating, >95% utilisation on operating days, capability of 5.5-6 crore litres/month; reduces sugarcane-season dependence. Karnataka High Court relief covers ~15 crore litres of unfulfilled ethanol allocation.
